accounts_goal_only_buckets.name: accounts_goal_only_buckets
accounts_goal_only_buckets.value: ("accounts"."goal_cents" is null and "accounts"."goal_date" is null) or "accounts"."is_bucket"

bank_transactions_posted_link.name: bank_transactions_posted_link
bank_transactions_posted_link.value: ("bank_transactions"."status" = 'posted') = ("bank_transactions"."entry_id" is not null and "bank_transactions"."post_method" is not null)

bucket_rules_amount_shape.name: bucket_rules_amount_shape
bucket_rules_amount_shape.value:
("bucket_rules"."kind" = 'percent' and "bucket_rules"."percent_bp" between 1 and 10000 and "bucket_rules"."amount_cents" is null)
        or ("bucket_rules"."kind" in ('fixed', 'monthly') and "bucket_rules"."amount_cents" > 0 and "bucket_rules"."percent_bp" is null)
